svg.text: Organization policy and tag bindings, Cloud Asset feeds, Workflows remediation
Audience: Engineer / auditor | Notation: GCP-style on AWS notation | Scope: GCP organization
deny where supported (Org Policy > Labeled resources)
tag bindings (Resource Manager tags > Labeled resources)
asset changes (Labeled resources > Cloud Asset Inventory)
feed (Cloud Asset Inventory > Asset feed topic)
Note: GCP labels are lowercase [a-z0-9_-] up to 63 chars: this is why the canonical standard is lowercase kebab-case everywhere (ADR-0001).
